# ACT Heir Marker (Template)

This `.act-heir.json.template` file ships with `Alex_ACT_Edition`. When a heir is deployed, the deployment script (or a manual one-time step) copies this template to `.github/.act-heir.json` and substitutes the placeholders.

## Placeholders

| Placeholder | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `{{EDITION_VERSION}}` | Edition release this heir is on | `0.1.0` |
| `{{HEIR_ID}}` | Stable slug, lowercase + hyphens | `acme-billing-act` |
| `{{HEIR_NAME}}` | Human-readable name | `Acme Billing ACT Heir` |
| `{{REPO_URL}}` | Repository URL | `https://github.com/acme/billing-act` |
| `{{DEPLOYED_AT}}` | ISO-8601 UTC timestamp | `2026-04-28T13:52:49Z` |
| `{{OWNER}}` | GitHub username or contact handle | `alice@acme` |

## One-time deployment step

```powershell
$now = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
$content = (Get-Content .github\.act-heir.json.template -Raw) `
    -replace '{{EDITION_VERSION}}','0.1.0' `
    -replace '{{HEIR_ID}}','my-heir-slug' `
    -replace '{{HEIR_NAME}}','My Heir Name' `
    -replace '{{REPO_URL}}','https://github.com/owner/repo' `
    -replace '{{DEPLOYED_AT}}',$now `
    -replace '{{OWNER}}','owner-handle'
$content | Set-Content .github\.act-heir.json -NoNewline
git add .github\.act-heir.json
```

After substitution, **delete the template** — only the rendered `.act-heir.json` belongs in the heir repo.

## Subsequent syncs

When the Edition is upgraded in a heir, only two fields change:

- `edition_version` — bump to the new Edition release
- `last_sync_at` — set to the upgrade timestamp

All other fields (heir_id, deployed_at, contact, opt_in) are heir-owned and never overwritten by the upgrade tooling.
